instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Joy Adeyemi. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Joy Adeyemi. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Care/HomeHelpers Nov 9-12.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-09 00:00 to 2026-11-13 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door and Garage Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Joy Adeyemi and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline in time zone America/New_York for the cameras Front Door and Garage Door on these dates only: 2026-11-10, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type all and limit 500. For each event return only its local time, its camera and whether the person was recognised as a known identity (yes or no). Do not return names, faces, plates, snapshots or other details.
